svg.aria-label: Two scatter plots sharing one vertical scale, 495 probes each. On the left, the coefficient against how far the edit actually moved the model: the points trend upward and Spearman is 0.522. On the right, the same coefficient against what is left once a same-subject control is removed: the cloud collapses onto the zero line and Spearman is 0.085, with an interval from -0.003 to 0.172 that crosses zero. In both panels the coefficient is bimodal — 329 probes sit at 0.8 or above and 127 at 0.2 or below, with only 39 in between — so the statistic is closer to a comparison of two groups than to a trend.

g.text: What is left after the control
